source: ours and sneed's (docs/design/stealth.md): RimWorld has no stealth
note: A fighter that isn't alerted sees only inside coneDegrees round its facing (anyone within closeSense is noticed all the same); alerted it looks all round. A target is seen from the sight range (FighterRules sightRange, less in fog) times a share for the light on it (darkSight in pitch dark up to 1 at fullLight) and, for a watcher that isn't alerted, for its stance (crouchSight, proneSight). Seen within instantRange it alerts at once; further off the watcher is suspicious first and alerted if the target is still in view noticeSteps later. Steps are game seconds, 30 a real second. Friends within calloutRadius of one who saw or heard an enemy itself learn where it is (sneed: 20 m); one alerted only by such a call doesn't call others (calledCanCall). Noise radii in metres: footsteps by gait (running is runSpeed metres a real second or more), gunNoise for a shot and meleeNoise for a blow unless the weapon's def has its own noiseRadius (bows 15, sneed's 8 m for melee), hitNoise round a pawn struck by a bullet, explosionNoise for a blast. With no enemy known an alerted fighter that nobody sent to fight is suspicious again after searchSeconds and unaware after suspiciousSeconds more. A fighter caught unaware waits surpriseSteps longer before it strikes back.
